title: LinkedIn Jobs Scraper input
description: Search public LinkedIn job postings by keyword and location, or paste LinkedIn jobs search URLs. No login or cookies. Every job row includes the public job details unless you turn them off.

keywords.title: Job titles or keywords
keywords.description: One search per keyword, for example "software engineer" or "registered nurse". LinkedIn boolean syntax such as "data (analyst OR scientist)" works. Leave empty when you only use search URLs or company IDs.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: City, region, or country as you would type it on LinkedIn, for example "Berlin, Germany", "United States", or "London Area, United Kingdom". Every keyword is searched in every location. Leave empty for a worldwide search.

searchUrls.title: LinkedIn jobs search URLs (optional)
searchUrls.description: Open https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/search/ in a private browser window, apply filters, and paste the address bar URL. Keywords, location, geoId, date posted, company, Easy Apply, under-10-applicants, and sort order are read from the URL.

datePosted.title: Date posted
datePosted.description: Only return jobs posted within this window. Use "Past 24 hours" for daily schedules.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Most relevant follows LinkedIn ranking; most recent orders by posting date and is the better choice for schedules and new-jobs-only mode.

companyIds.title: Company IDs (optional)
companyIds.description: Numeric LinkedIn company IDs, for example 1441 for Google. Found as f_C in a LinkedIn jobs search URL. Restricts every search to these companies.

geoId.title: Geo ID (optional)
geoId.description: LinkedIn numeric geoId for exact location targeting, found as geoId in a LinkedIn jobs search URL. Overrides the free-text locations.

easyApplyOnly.title: Easy Apply only
easyApplyOnly.description: Only return jobs that can be applied to with LinkedIn Easy Apply.

under10Applicants.title: Under 10 applicants only
under10Applicants.description: Only return jobs that LinkedIn marks as having fewer than 10 applicants.

workplaceType.title: Workplace type
workplaceType.description: Remote, hybrid, or on-site. LinkedIn stopped applying this as a public search filter in August 2026, so the selection is added to the search text instead; treat it as a strong hint, not a guarantee.

jobType.title: Job type
jobType.description: Added to the search text for the same reason as workplace type.

experienceLevel.title: Experience level
experienceLevel.description: Added to the search text for the same reason as workplace type.

maxJobsPerSearch.title: Maximum jobs per search
maxJobsPerSearch.description: Cost and time cap for each keyword and location combination. LinkedIn's public search never returns more than 1,000 jobs per search; split by city or narrow the date window for more.

includeJobDetails.title: Include job details
includeJobDetails.description: Fetch every job's public detail page: description, seniority level, employment type, job function, industries, applicants, and company logo. Turn off for a fast list of titles, companies, locations, and dates only.

newJobsOnly.title: New jobs only (skip jobs seen in earlier runs)
newJobsOnly.description: Remembers every job ID per watchlist namespace and returns only jobs that were not seen before. Ideal for daily schedules: you pay only for new postings. The first run returns everything.

stateNamespace.title: Watchlist namespace
stateNamespace.description: Separates independent new-jobs-only histories. "auto" isolates each saved Task automatically; API callers should set a stable unique value per watchlist.

verifyApplyLinks.title: Verify official apply links and ghost-job risk
verifyApplyLinks.description: Optional premium step. Sends the scraped jobs to the LinkedIn Job Apply Link Verifier Actor, which returns the official employer application URL, live status, confidence, and ghost-job risk into the same rows. Billed separately by that Actor.

maxJobsToVerify.title: Maximum jobs to verify
maxJobsToVerify.description: Cost guardrail for the optional apply-link verification in one run.

verificationMaxTotalChargeUsd.title: Verification cost limit
verificationMaxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum pay-per-event charge allowed for the verifier run.

verifierActorId.title: Verifier Actor
verifierActorId.description: Actor used for optional apply-link verification.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel job detail requests. Higher values are faster but raise the chance of LinkedIn rate limits; the Actor retries with fresh proxy sessions.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy is used by default and included in the price. Each search and each job detail request uses its own proxy session.
